scope: Studio only; no UE migration or UICreator art/control changes

behavior.generation: Dragging, zooming and keyboard navigation project the deterministic procedural world into the current viewport. Generation is not limited to the initial ten-ring disk or triggered only by battle completion.
behavior.identity: Seed plus axial coordinates determine node position, biome, name and bidirectional roads. Revisiting a position does not reroll it.
behavior.progression: Existing fog and connected-road unlocking remain in effect. Browsing neither explores nor unlocks regions and never charges map tickets.
behavior.saves: Existing version-one seed and progression saves remain compatible; disposable viewport nodes and terrain tiles are not persisted.
behavior.memory: Replace the render window as the camera moves, rather than accumulating every browsed node. Terrain uses 1024-world-unit tiles, 384px rasters, at most one new raster per frame and a 64-tile LRU cache. Eviction and unmount release canvas storage.
behavior.presentation: Retains the existing engraved procedural terrain, fog, node and road styles, and authored UICreator controls. Player location and region details stay attached to progression while the camera moves away.
